title: Made this game 100% using detailed prompts
author: No-Thought-4864
selftext:
I have tried a combination of workflows in the past with 

\- Using AI Studio for generating base code then moving the codebase to cursor for further development

\- Using Codex/Claude Code for coding and DALL-E/Nanobanana + ComfyUI for assets

But I have struggled to get them to work in cohesion. Yeah they were good for quick prototypes but somehow was not confident sharing those creations, until now.

I have been developing games for over a decade on Unity and Phaser, professionally as a game designer and personally as a hobby game dev. So I have always had game ideas, never had the full pipeline skills. I have hired a lot in the past on Upwork but man I have wasted a lot on wringing it all together. 

Now though I am genuinely excited. 

I tested the following platforms to see which ones generate my ideas well. Rosebud, Oasiz, Jabali, Playabl etc. but none of them were good at creating 2D games as I prefer developing 2D casual games.  
  
I found one tool in my tests to consistently develop good outputs and the devs are active in listening to my rant about what worked and didn't. So just wanted to share the game here that I made which i feel somewhat confident in sharing  
  
[Bramble Brawl](https://studio.makermint.com/play/bramble-brawl?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=clipboard&utm_campaign=game_share&utm_content=bramble-brawl)

Hopefully you guys have fun with the game concept and let me know if I should continue building this out further with more levels etc.

[Made on Makermint Studio. https:\/\/studio.makermint.com](https://preview.redd.it/pwa4juhtwcng1.png?width=1536&format=png&auto=webp&s=d2e07bc1afd9b9b251a72083179cfbc0229f9838)

comments.author: True_Audience_198
comments.body:
bro the upwork part hit me lmao i have mass graveyard of half finished projects from freelancers who "totally understood the vision"

curious tho when you say detailed prompts — like are you writing full on design docs before prompting or is it more back and forth? cause i always end up in this loop of trying to explain what i want and the AI just... vibes in the wrong direction

also you tested rosebud oasiz jabali etc — what were they actually getting wrong with 2D? like was it the movement feeling janky or the code being spaghetti or what. asking cause ive been looking for something decent for 2D stuff and everything i try feels like it was made by someone whos never actually played a game lol

gonna go try bramble brawl now

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body:
Yeah I am struggling with finding something decent that I can quickly whip out and share for early feedback. For this one I asked the generative engine to "create a game inspired by TMNT classics" and then went down the rabbit hole of edit prompting. Problem with other generative engines was the output was not even worth sharing 🫣 i.e. either they were not playable or just looked lame.

https://preview.redd.it/x9j5u7dk4dng1.png?width=514&format=png&auto=webp&s=d927dcad826b1c5408e4f98f60c39facadc56818

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Controls were not working and all the sprites were just "hanging about"

comments.author: Historical-Wrap-442
comments.body: Cool! Love the aesthetic- reminded me of a darker 'Animals of Farthing Wood'. Collision was a little off though for punching etc. Would love to see some more levels and enemy types if you get back onto it!

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Sorry had to look up the game 🫣 Yeah the game came out ok but I was like.. "f$ it am gonna just share it and not keep things in my idea list for eternity"

comments.author: rakisibahomaka
comments.body: If this was in a 48h game jam, it would place last. Probably one of the worst things I have seen.

replies.author: True_Audience_198
replies.body: I think it would be second last, mate

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Damn that hurts but ok. A team of 2 or 3 creating this in 48hrs vs. 3 prompts in 15mins? Maybe the next game i'll make will be better.

replies.author: rakisibahomaka
replies.body: This is your sign to spend more than 15 minutes lol. So much for “detailed prompts”.

replies.author: Impressive_Award_679
replies.body: the problem is not that you use ai. We are in the aigamedevs sub. The problem is that you simply prompt something just pretty fast und think "thats it lets show this to people". Thats not how you should work with ai. if u only shovel out non-working 15 minute games like this, you will mostly get comments like this. A game game, even with ai, needs months or atleast a few weeks to be something really playable.

replies.author: big-pill-to-swallow
replies.body: Has been developing games for 10 years then needs ai to produce this crap. Something doesn’t add up

comments.author: E_den
comments.body: Can't even spend enough time to make it look good for your own stealth ads, that's a bit sad

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Does not look like a great ad from the comments shared here. 😅

comments.author: Guilty_Bad9902
comments.body:
Jesus Christ man. How much of your post is a lie? A professional game designer? There's no way you played this crap and felt it was worthwhile to show people. "Let me know if I should continue building this out" Are you serious?

You think someone's gonna come in here saying "holy shit I love this thoughtless sidescroller that barely works! fuckkkk I love these ai generated animals. i've been dying for something so barebones, so incomplete, so amateur. this has completed me. please make more!!!"

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Thank you for the constructive feedback. Would rather fail sooner and get these comments.

comments.author: PeterDck
comments.body:
Eu acredito que muito pode ser melhorado nesse jogo, como botões de controle muito genéricos, animações inconsistentes ou inexistentes, personagens flutuando, novas mecânicas etc. 
Entendo que se trata de um protótipo, que você quis compartilhar o seu trabalho para entender se está no caminho certo. Esse não é o tipo de jogo que eu jogaria, não no estado em que se encontra, então acho que poderia se dedicar mais a esse trabalho e talvez transformá-lo em um jogo mobile, acredito que desta forma tenha mais saída.

comments.author: PeterDck
comments.body:
Trabalho com IA é algo que também leva tempo, carece de polimento, e muito importante, tente evitar ao máximo parecer com algo genérico feito por IA, de o seu estilo, de o seu toque pessoal. 
Invista mais tempo, e não se deixa abater. 
Projetos também são aprendizados, se não funcionar, bola para frente, tente outra coisa, mas não desanime.

replies.author: No-Thought-4864
replies.body: Thank you for the most encouraging words 🙏

comments.author: mrpoopybruh
